Imagens criadas com a ferramenta integrada image_gen. Originais em Generated05; texturas importadas em Resources/RpgArt. Atlas recortados, registrados pelo pé e reduzidos para células de 64px pelo importador. Sem desenho procedural de personagens.

STONE
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: original seamless tiling terrain texture for a detailed top-down 2D pixel-art RPG. A completely flat overhead material swatch of irregular rounded weathered cobblestones, small soft-edged river stones and old worn paving stones set into earthy sand, subtle moss in crevices, occasional tiny grass sprigs. NO rectangular paving grid, NO diamonds, NO square tiles, NO large flagstones, NO outlines marking a tile boundary. Stones of varied rounded shapes and sizes, organically packed, muted warm gray, slate gray, sandstone and moss green, soft hand-painted pixel shading from upper left, restrained contrast so a small game character stays readable. Beautiful richly detailed 32-bit-era pixel RPG terrain like an expertly hand-painted fantasy RPG tileset, consistent fine pixel clusters. No perspective horizon, no objects above the floor, no buildings, no character, no scene or map layout. Fill the complete square canvas with the material, seamless wrapping on all edges, evenly distributed detail, no vignette, no border, no text, no labels or watermarks.

GRASS
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: original seamless top-down terrain texture for a refined pixel-art 2D fantasy RPG. A square material swatch of lush Brazilian meadow grass, finely detailed varied curved blades, soft tufts, clover-sized round leaves, a few tiny pale wildflowers, scattered darker moss patches and subtle earthy gaps. Restrained natural olive, sage and forest greens with warm sunlit tips; NO fluorescent lime. Beautiful hand-painted 32-bit pixel RPG texture with small clean clusters and soft organic shading, matching detailed RPG sprites. Ground material only, absolutely no trees, trunks, rocks, buildings, objects, paths, character or horizon. Continuous uneven organic distribution, no rows, no rectangular patches, no tile grid, no vignette, no border. Even overall illumination, seamless wrapping at every edge. Fine visual detail but calm readable background for a small yellow-shirt character. Entire square canvas filled, no text, labels or watermarks.

TRANSITION
Use case: identity-preserve / game sprite animation. Create an actual transparent production SPRITE ATLAS, exactly SIX equal columns and FOUR equal rows, landscape aspect ratio 3:2, all 24 full-body figures separated by generous transparent margins, no labels, no grid lines. References: image 1 is the current golden transformed hero in four directions; image 2 is his normal form. Preserve this recognizable Brazilian male pixel RPG hero: warm brown skin, yellow Brazil jersey with green collar/sleeve edges, blue trousers, dark shoes. Match the same detailed LPC-style small chunky clean pixel clusters, top-down 3/4 RPG camera, not a large anime illustration. NEW ART FOR A TRANSFORMATION SEQUENCE: broader powerful shoulders/chest, visible stronger forearms, jersey stretched with a few torn sleeve edges, distinct aggressive angular golden hair flaring upward and outward. No aura, no background, no glow, no cast shadows: effects added separately by game. ROWS in EXACT order: row 1 facing NORTH with back visible; row 2 facing WEST with left profile visible; row 3 facing SOUTH with face visible; row 4 facing EAST with right profile visible. All six figures of each row keep exactly that orientation. COLUMNS in chronological order: 1 normal dark curly hair, knees bent, fists tight at waist anticipating; 2 knees bend deeper, shoulders tense, dark hair lifts into spikes; 3 rises as torso expands and spikes lengthen with first gold highlights; 4 explosive open arms/raised fists, fully golden spiky hair, expanded chest; 5 lowers arms into strong battle-ready stance, golden hair settles; 6 finished powerful golden form in relaxed battle-ready idle, same hair silhouette as reference 1 but with stronger torso and forearms. Anchor both feet to the SAME horizontal baseline at 84 percent down every cell, keep pelvis centered horizontally in each cell. Slight rise in height and body width is intentional, no drifting between cells, no cropped hair or hands. Character occupies about central 55 percent cell width and 75 percent cell height. Transparent alpha background everywhere except the character. Crisp deliberate pixel art, no painted blur, no words or watermarks. This is new artwork of the hero across his transformation, it must include EVERY one of the 24 requested cells.

WALK
Use case: game sprite animation asset. Generate a transparent production pixel-art SPRITE SHEET using ONLY the finished golden powered-up hero from the LAST TWO COLUMNS of the reference. Same identity EXACTLY: brown skin, powerful shoulders and forearms, spiky golden hair, determined face, yellow Brazil jersey with green trim and small torn sleeve edges, blue trousers, dark shoes. Same RPG top-down 3/4 camera and crisp detailed pixel clusters as reference, NOT a painted illustration. Exactly FOUR ROWS: row1 facing NORTH/back, row2 facing WEST/left profile, row3 facing SOUTH/front, row4 facing EAST/right profile. Never change facing within a row. All cells equal square size, feet/ground baseline consistently at 84% down cell and pelvis centered, character about 70-75% cell height, transparent generous margins, NO backgrounds, no shadows, no aura/glow/speed lines, no weapons, no words or gridlines. Keep clothing, body proportions, golden hair and color palette absolutely consistent in every frame. Every frame must be a deliberately different animation pose, with good natural weight transfer. Exactly 8 COLUMNS and FOUR ROWS, 32 complete sprites. A smooth eight-frame WALK cycle, one complete cycle left and right steps. Natural opposite arms and legs, planted foot contact at frames 1 and 5, recoil at 2 and 6, passing at 3 and 7, high point at4 and8. Calm purposeful walking, low knees.
